title: DATEADD by DAY shifts every date and keeps the number of days
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = DATEADD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, DAY ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 2, 1 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 2, 29 ) )

source.quote: If the interval is DAY , every Date[Date] value is shifted by the number of intervals specified.
source.supports: the article shifts February 2019 back one day and gets 2019-01-31 to 2019-02-27, still 28 days

derivation: Each of the 29 days of February 2024 moves back one day: January 31 to February 28, 29 days (the whole-month rule does not apply to DAY). Sales: Jan 31 200 + Feb 10 300 = 500; Feb 29 is no longer included.
